_: ОДИННАДЦАТЬ ТИПОВ СЕКЦИЙ — по назначению, а не по устройству (владелец 2026-08-22).
Каталог видов отвечает «что бывает»; для выбора этого мало — двадцать девять имён не говорят,
какое ставить, когда нужен «раздел про шаги». Тип отвечает на вопрос НАЗНАЧЕНИЯ: сначала он,
Первые десять — классическая раскладка лендинга, пришли от владельца целиком. Одиннадцатый
добавлен, чтобы ни один вид не остался без дома: половина каталога это МАТЕРИАЛ страницы.
ЧИСТЫЕ ДАННЫЕ, не TypeScript: файл читает генератор и панель, а приложению он не нужен вовсе.
`shape` — как рисовать превью в панели: панель и приложение разные приложения, код рендереров
она импортировать не может, поэтому рисует схему своими примитивами. Неизвестная форма честно

types.title: Hero
types.purpose: First impression, clear positioning and the main offer above the fold.
types.variants: Classic (heading + text + button + visual), hero with a signup form, minimal with video background, hero slider.

types.title: Benefits and value
types.purpose: The key benefit for the user, told as claims with icons.
types.variants: A 2x2 or 3x2 grid of cards, blocks with large icons, alternating rows (Z-pattern).

types.title: How it works
types.purpose: A step-by-step explanation of the purchase, the interaction or the service.
types.variants: Horizontal step cards (1-2-3), a vertical timeline, an animated demo with stage switching.

types.title: Product in action
types.purpose: Showing the interface, the physical product or a key feature.
types.variants: Interactive tabs, a video walkthrough, cards with hover effects, a clickable mock-up.

types.title: Use cases
types.purpose: Segmenting the audience: how the product solves the tasks of a role or an industry.
types.variants: Tabs by role ("for marketers", "for developers"), problem-and-solution cards.

types.title: Comparison
types.purpose: Setting the product apart from competitors or from the old way of solving the problem.
types.variants: A tick-and-cross table, "before / after" plates, a vertical head-to-head block.

types.title: Pricing and plans
types.purpose: An honest view of prices, what each package holds and how payment works.
types.variants: Plan cards with one marked "popular", a monthly/yearly switch, a price calculator.

types.title: Testimonials and social proof
types.purpose: Confirming quality through the real experience of other people.
types.variants: A slider of quotes with photos, a grid of social screenshots, video testimonials, rating cards.

types.title: Cases and portfolio
types.purpose: Measurable results of the work, or the look of what was made.
types.variants: A filterable grid, "task — solution — result in %" cards, before/after sliders.

types.title: Trust and logos
types.purpose: Reading the scale and reliability of the brand at a glance.
types.variants: A marquee or grid of client and press logos, plates with key metrics, certificates.

types.title: Page material
types.purpose: What a page is written FROM: paragraphs, lists, quotes, tables, code, callouts.
types.variants: Not a landing section at all — building material that lives inside any of the ten above.
